description: 8 retrieval probes for slimphp/Slim — an MIT-licensed PHP micro-framework with abstract/final class modifiers, interface implementation, and PSR-7/PSR-15 HTTP middleware chains.

probes.query: how does slim dispatch HTTP requests through the middleware pipeline
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: MiddlewareDispatcher class implements MiddlewareDispatcherInterface — composes the PSR-15 middleware chain

probes.query: how does slim collect and register routes via the fluent route builder
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: RouteCollector class implements RouteCollectorInterface — owns the route table

probes.query: how does slim resolve callable handlers from class names callables or container entries
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: CallableResolver translates string/array/Closure callables into invocable handlers
Symbol-anchored probe: App extends RouteCollectorProxy implements RequestHandlerInterface — the top-level application class
Symbol-anchored probe: Route implements RouteInterface, RequestHandlerInterface (line 40) — concrete route with handler + middleware

probes.query: Slim FastRouteDispatcher class wrapping nikic FastRoute
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: FastRouteDispatcher wraps the nikic/fast-route library

probes.query: Slim CallableResolver final class with interface inheritance
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: `final class CallableResolver implements AdvancedCallableResolverInterface` (line 32) — exercises PHP's `final` class modifier combined with interface implementation

probes.query: Slim App constructor accepting ResponseFactoryInterface and container dependencies
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: App::__construct (line 55) takes multiple typed nullable parameters (`?ContainerInterface $container = null`, `?CallableResolverInterface $callableResolver = null`, etc.). Exercises tree-sitter-php's parsing of typed nullable parameters with defaults across a multi-line constructor signature
